method.candidate_source: Real en-ja seed frontier plus profile-growth scoring; saved-page browsing effects enter only through preview_browsing_admission_refresh.
method.saved_page_signal_scope: Local saved-page fixtures are converted to reading-aware browsing aggregate keys, then compared against the real candidate frontier.
method.production_effect: None. This harness builds a temporary browsing store and never mutates live SRS state.

policy.source_mapping: English page tokens are matched only to exact JMDict glosses.
policy.target_mapping: Japanese ruby pairs are treated as exact readings; non-ruby surface matches fall back to JMDict with confidence damped by ambiguity.

scenarios.name: neutral_p35_saved_pages
scenarios.description: Neutral learner near early intermediate proficiency; checks whether saved-page signals can add relevant story words without profile-topic help.

findings.message: Browsing lane share is monotonic.
Browsing preview did not mutate SRS.
Strong preset realized browsing lane.
Saved-page aggregate matched enough real admission candidates (53 >= 5).
Strong preview rows expose raw and effective browsing signal fields.
No hygiene-rejected saved-page signals were selected.
